target.host: Namecheap Stellar Business (cPanel, CloudLinux, Phusion Passenger)
target.runtime: Node.js >= 20.9 via cPanel Setup Node.js App (selector path /opt/alt/alt-nodejsNN/root/usr/bin/node)
target.reverseProxy: Passenger (reverse port binding; app must .listen() once on the supplied PORT)

artifact.builder: deploy/namecheap/build-artifact.mjs (off-server ONLY; webpack standalone; Turbopack banned per 2026-07-23 incident)

identity.buildTime: release.json + receipt.json at artifact root, gitSha = full 40-hex commit
identity.runtime: GET /api/release -> RELEASE_SHA_PRESENT with the exact SHA; 503 RELEASE_SHA_MISSING/INVALID when absent or malformed; never fabricated
identity.tests: apps/web/tests/release-sha.test.mjs + isolated runtime test inside the builder

conditional: prisma/migrations/** — shipped verbatim only when the migration lane has committed them; never authored by the builder

commands.deploy: sh ~/uploads/deploy.sh orderweeddc-<shortsha>.tar.gz   (or verify-and-deploy.sh for the gated one-command path)
commands.initializeDatabase: cd <app-home>/current && sh bootstrap-production-db.sh   (first deploy only; guarded, idempotent, zero demo data)
commands.migrate: cd <app-home>/current && sh migrate.sh   (applies apps/web/prisma/migrations/** BY CONVENTION; hard-stops when the migration lane has not landed)
commands.rollback: sh <app-home>/rollback.sh   (code-only swap to previous; database never touched)
commands.readinessCheck: OWD_EXPECTED_SHA=<sha> sh readycheck.sh <base-url>   (health + provenance + SHA equality + render)
commands.smokeTest: sh smoke-test.sh <base-url>   (full read-only battery; writes an environment-labelled receipt)
commands.workerOnce: node worker.mjs --once   (cron tick: backup + health jobs; mkdir lock; SIGTERM-graceful)
commands.restoreBackup: sh restore-backup.sh <backup.db> <target-path>   (checksum-gated; refuses to overwrite without FORCE=1)

environment.manifest: deploy/namecheap/ENV_MANIFEST.md (names only — values are owner-supplied at the cPanel panel, never in git)

receiptDiscipline.rule: NO staging receipt may state or imply that production is live.
receiptDiscipline.enforcement: smoke-test.sh labels every receipt 'staging' unless OWD_ENVIRONMENT=production AND OWD_CONFIRM_PRODUCTION=1; staging receipts carry an explicit no-production-claim sentence.
